sections.title: Walk from the cave entrance → Hunter

steps.title: Enter the low stone door
steps.direction: Find the low rock opening among the trees and enter the tunnel. The Ghillie gear and Cactus Broth in the clip reduce detection, but do not touch creatures.

steps.title: Follow the path down · 1/2
steps.direction: Follow the tunnel down to the chamber with glowing plants. Compare the ledge in the next GIF before turning.

steps.title: Through the water section · 1/2
steps.direction: Continue along the stone floor through the chamber with water and glowing blue plants. Keep your distance from cave creatures.

steps.title: Get Hunter · 1/2
steps.direction: Follow the stone platform to the glowing blue Artifact. Collect Hunter and retrace your entry route.

sections.title: Walk from the cave entrance → Clever

steps.title: Enter Central Cave
steps.direction: Find the stone door under the wall as shown in the GIF. Walk into the blue and orange hallway.

steps.title: Follow the hallway to the last room · 1/2
steps.direction: Follow the stone path through chambers with glowing plants. Pause at the end of each GIF to identify the next passage.

steps.title: Follow the hallway to the last room · 2/2
Go to the stone platform to get Clever
steps.direction: Approach the stone platform in the final chamber and collect Clever. Stop exploring deeper once you have the Artifact.

steps.title: Enter the door between the trees · 1/2
steps.direction: Enter beneath the vine-covered cliff and descend through the tunnel to the lava area. Prepare Grapple and Parachute before the chasms.

steps.title: Enter the door between the trees · 2/2
Grapple through the early abyss · 1/2
steps.direction: Fire Grapple into solid rock above to cross the gap. Do not jump into lava.

steps.title: Follow the narrow ledge · 1/2
steps.direction: Follow the ledge around the lava as shown in the GIF. Stop on safe ground before continuing.

steps.title: Through the stone paths · 1/3
steps.direction: Walk and jump across low ledges through the red-rock tunnel. Jump only when you can clearly see the landing spot.

steps.title: Reach the Artifact chamber · 1/2
steps.direction: Follow the stone path into the chamber with plants and mushrooms. Circle along solid ground toward the Artifact glow.

steps.title: Get Massive
steps.direction: Approach the Artifact on the ledge beside the lava and collect Massive. Keep Grapple ready to cross the gaps on your return.

steps.title: Upper South entrance · 1/2
steps.direction: Enter the low stone opening and follow the tunnel with glowing plants. The clip travels on foot; bring Parachute, Grapple, and SCUBA for the inner levels.

steps.title: Down to the main hall · 1/3
steps.direction: Follow the path around plants and stone pillars to the broad chamber lit from above.

steps.title: Lower with Parachute · 1/2
steps.direction: Deploy Parachute while descending to the planted stone platform. Check the landing spot in the GIF before stepping off the edge.

steps.title: Follow the path around the wall · 1/4
steps.direction: Continue through corridors with glowing plants, following the stone floor around the wall toward the water.

steps.title: Follow the path around the wall · 2/4
Follow the path around the wall · 3/4
Follow the path around the wall · 4/4
Grapple and into the lake · 1/3
steps.direction: Use Grapple at the high ledge as shown in the GIF, then descend to the lake. Check SCUBA gear before diving.

steps.title: Through the underwater passage · 1/2
steps.direction: Swim through the underwater tunnel, surface, then follow the crevice covered in glowing blue plants.

steps.title: Get Pack
steps.direction: Reach the Artifact at the end of the crevice and collect Pack. Keep enough diving gear and Grapple for the return.

steps.title: Through the snow cave door · 1/2
steps.direction: Find the small opening between the rocks and snow. Crouch through the low passages, following the dark corridor into the cave.

steps.title: Follow the narrow rock crevice · 1/2
steps.direction: Follow the narrow path between rocks. Use a torch to identify the route; do not rush over drops.

steps.title: Grapple through the gap
steps.direction: Fire Grapple into the opposite wall as shown in the GIF to cross the chasm. Check your landing position before releasing the rope.

steps.title: Get Skylord
steps.direction: The Artifact is in the rock alcove ahead. Collect Skylord and return using Grapple and the narrow entry route.

sections.title: Swimming with SCUBA and Cactus Broth → Brute

steps.title: Dive to the west door · 1/2
steps.direction: From the west coast, equip SCUBA and use Cactus Broth before diving. The structure on shore in the clip is a player's house.

steps.title: Follow the crevice with yellow plants · 1/3
steps.direction: Dive through the crevice between rocks, following glowing yellow plants to the white crystal area.

steps.title: Follow the crevice with yellow plants · 2/3
Follow the crevice with yellow plants · 3/3
Through the crystal tunnel · 1/3
steps.direction: Follow the underwater path between white crystal clusters. Avoid touching creatures; Cactus Broth does not make you invulnerable.

steps.title: Round the columns · 1/4
steps.direction: Swim around large stone pillars and yellow plants. Compare every turn with the GIF before continuing.

steps.title: Upstairs with air · 1/2
steps.direction: Surface in the red-rock chamber, climb onto the rest platform, and check your SCUBA tank. Recover stamina before the next dive.

steps.title: Diving through the bright seaweed · 1/3
steps.direction: Return to the pool ahead and follow the tall yellow-green plants and white crystals.

steps.title: Cling to the wall to Artifact · 1/3
steps.direction: Pass through the gap beneath the stone arch and follow the rock floor toward the Artifact glow. Check stamina and oxygen before reaching the bottom.

steps.title: Cling to the wall to Artifact · 2/3
Cling to the wall to Artifact · 3/3
Get Brute
steps.direction: Approach the Artifact and collect Brute, then return to the air chamber along the same swimming route.

sections.title: Swimming with SCUBA and Cactus Broth → Cunning

steps.title: Find the door under the east wall · 1/2
steps.direction: Dive to the cave entrance beside the eastern ocean cliff. The gate in the clip was placed by a player; find the natural rock entrance behind it.

steps.title: Find the door under the east wall · 2/2
Follow the path between the bright tree · 1/4
steps.direction: Swim through the tunnel with glowing yellow and blue plants. The clip uses Cactus Broth; avoid bumping creatures and triggering combat.

steps.title: Follow the path between the bright tree · 2/4
Follow the path between the bright tree · 3/4
Follow the path between the bright tree · 4/4
Through the twists and turns · 1/3
steps.direction: Follow the stone pillars and yellow plants around the bends in the GIF. Do not switch branches before identifying the correct wall.

steps.title: Go to shallow water · 1/3
steps.direction: Pass between the rocks into shallow water and find a route up to the platform with air.

steps.title: Go to the resting platform
steps.direction: Climb onto the stone platform under the yellow plants, recover stamina, and check SCUBA. The chairs are player-placed objects, not natural cave landmarks.

steps.title: Pass through the blue crevice to collect Cunning · 1/2
steps.direction: When ready, leave the rest platform through the blue-lit gap. Cunning is in the purple-lit alcove immediately behind it.

steps.title: Pass through the blue crevice to collect Cunning · 2/2
Carnivore Island Entrance · 1/3
steps.direction: Find the stone entrance on northeastern Carnivore Island. The house at the cave mouth was built by a player; the natural entrance is behind it.

steps.title: Go down to the lake and reach the cliff · 1/3
steps.direction: Cross the water and climb the stone path to the large chamber with glowing blue plants. The clip uses Thylacoleo to traverse ledges.

steps.title: Go down to the lake and reach the cliff · 2/3
Go down to the lake and reach the cliff · 3/3
Follow the edge around the cliff · 1/5
steps.direction: Follow the rock floor around the chasm. Clear blocking creatures; do not jump directly from the high ledge to the bottom.

steps.title: Follow the edge around the cliff · 2/5
Follow the edge around the cliff · 3/5
Follow the edge around the cliff · 4/5
Follow the edge around the cliff · 5/5
Use Grapple over the ledge · 1/4
steps.direction: Dismount on the safe platform and use Grapple across ledges and down to the lower level as shown in the GIF. Keep Grapple for the return trip.

steps.title: Go through the room below · 1/4
steps.direction: Continue with Thyla through the lower chamber with glowing plants and crystals. Clear insects and spiders before entering the Artifact area.

steps.title: Go to the ruins in the cave · 1/3
steps.direction: Pass between stone pillars to the ruins with a tall doorway. Clear all creatures around the dismount point.

steps.title: Go to the ruins in the cave · 2/3
Go to the ruins in the cave · 3/3
Get Devourer · 1/2
steps.direction: The Artifact glows purple beside the ruins. Approach, dismount when safe, and collect Devourer.

sections.title: Baryonyx from the cave entrance → Immune

steps.title: Find the low stone door
steps.direction: Find the small opening in Redwoods at the entrance GPS above. Equip complete gas protection and spares before entering; check the cave's equipment checklist.

steps.title: Ride Baryonyx into the cave · 1/2
steps.direction: Go into the low tunnel, follow the stone floor to the green space. The structure outside the door in the clip was built by the player.

steps.title: Through the first room · 1/3
steps.direction: Clear insects and Arthropleura blocking the route shown in the GIF. Arthro can break armor; check gas protection after combat.

steps.title: Follow the path around the wall · 1/3
steps.direction: Follow the stone floor around the wall through connected chambers. The diagram in the clip's upper corner helps identify your current route.

steps.title: Follow the path around the wall · 2/3
Follow the path around the wall · 3/3
Round the wide space · 1/3
steps.direction: Clear creatures from the broad chamber and continue along the stone path. Pause at each section's end to compare the next wall and entrance.

steps.title: Find the gap into the alcove · 1/2
steps.direction: Follow the path to the small leaf-covered gap shown in the GIF. Dismount when safe and clear the narrow passage.

steps.title: Find the gap into the alcove · 2/2
Go to Immune
steps.direction: Immune glows orange in an alcove covered with yellow leaves. Approach and collect the Artifact, then retrace the passages you followed.

steps.title: Find the cave entrance in the snow
steps.direction: This route uses Tek Chestpiece, Tek Boots, Tek Rifle, and Element; follow it only after unlocking and preparing all of them. Without Tek, open the full video for the Yutyrannus route.

steps.title: Enter the door and cross the first lake · 1/2
steps.direction: Enter the rock crevice in the snow and follow the corridor to the first lake. Check warm gear and Element reserves before diving.

steps.title: Enter the door and cross the first lake · 2/2
Fly through the first room · 1/3
steps.direction: Use Tek Chestpiece to fly along the player's route. This flight section does not apply to travel on foot; keep enough Element to return.

steps.title: Go to the ledge in front of the large room · 1/2
steps.direction: Follow the hallway to the ledge looking down into the main room. Stop on solid ground before engaging.

steps.title: Go to the ledge in front of the large room · 2/2
Clear animals from high ledges · 1/2
steps.direction: Use Tek Rifle to clear creatures from high ledges. Continue when the descent is safe; the long fight has been shortened.

steps.title: Continue through the ice chamber · 1/4
steps.direction: Leave the ledge, follow the platform, and fly through the broad chamber. Clear blocking creatures before reaching the next corridor.

steps.title: Through the blue crystal cluster · 1/3
steps.direction: Follow the path next to the blue crystal to the narrow door. Clear out the animals in the hallway before going deeper.

steps.title: Reach the Yeti chamber · 1/4
steps.direction: Follow the ice tunnel to the open Yeti chamber. Check your landing platform and keep your distance while using Tek Rifle.

steps.title: Clear Yeti in front of the entrance
steps.direction: Clear creatures from this chamber before approaching the Artifact. The stationary fighting scene has been shortened; do not skip clearing the route.

steps.title: Follow the path to alcove Artifact · 1/3
steps.direction: When the chamber is safe, follow the ice corridors in the GIF. Compare each turn and stone platform before flying onward.

steps.title: Follow the path to alcove Artifact · 2/3
Follow the path to alcove Artifact · 3/3
Get Strong · 1/2
steps.direction: Strong is in the alcove at the route's end. Approach the green-lit Artifact Container and collect the Artifact; keep enough Element, warm gear, and ammunition to return.
